title: Sync fixes, round 3 — the too-big warning, collapsed

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when a conversation is too big to sync
steps.headline: The too-big warning is now one line: 2 conversations too big to sync.
steps.changed: The orange warning card starts closed, showing only a one-line header that says how many conversations are affected.
steps.notice: The sync box stays short; click the line to see more.
steps.risk: The reason and the names are hidden until you click.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync → click the orange line
steps.headline: Opened, the card explains the 50 MB limit and lists the conversations by name.
steps.changed: Clicking the header opens the same card to the explanation and the conversation names.
steps.notice: Everything about the problem is in one place, inside the warning.
